chapter: Reel 3: defining jazz and the blues
title: Jazz did not originate only in New Orleans
summary: Jazz arose in many places, and Kansas City and New Orleans groups play the same blues differently.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: We were talking about jazz -- people coming up with where jazz originated, and you had some attitudes, you had some feelings about that.
Yeah, well ... jazz originated all over the United States in certain spots. Didn't just -- jazz just wasn't born in New Orleans.
Uh huh. I wanted you to say that for the tape because a lot of people say that, and they talk about Chicago and they talk about Kansas City, but --

Sure, they had their music out there. They had their way of feeling about the blues. You will notice if you get a group from Kansas City and a group from New Orleans, they play the same song, the same blues, and it just won't be the same. There's a difference in the way they play it.
Each one has its own stamp, its own brand.
Sure, so you see, it just couldn't be that way.
